data.label: SAEP
data.description: SAEP（Screen Automation Execution Protocol，屏幕自动化执行协议）允许应用声明约束 Agent 屏幕自动化操作的保护策略。应用通过 application 级元数据 com.obric.agentrobots.POLICY_JSON 引用打包的静态策略资源。此规则仅识别该静态策略声明，不验证策略内容，也不代表设备已启用 SAEP 或保护规则当前生效。

data.label: SAEP
data.description: SAEP (Screen Automation Execution Protocol) lets apps declare protection policies that constrain Agent screen automation. The application metadata com.obric.agentrobots.POLICY_JSON references a packaged static policy resource. This rule identifies the static declaration only; it does not validate the policy or confirm that SAEP is enabled on the device or that protection rules are enforced.
